tool.name: axe-core
tool.acquisition: Taken from an existing local npm install whose lockfile pins the registry integrity above (the same version and integrity as the 5 October scan); not vendored. Three separate local installs had the same axe.min.js SHA-256.

environment: The three regenerated evidence-viewer pages, copied to a scratch folder and opened as local files; no console was started and the pages load no network resources. Viewport 1280x900, light and dark color schemes.
scope: Rescan of the three evidence viewer pages only, after their final rebuild on 27 October 2026. It replaces the earlier same-day viewer rescan (docs/evidence/20261027-accessibility-axe-scan-viewer.json), which covered the pages before a wording-only rebuild. Console pages were not rescanned; their templates and stylesheets have not changed since the 5 October scan (docs/evidence/20261005-accessibility-axe-scan.json).
limits: Automated rules catch only part of WCAG; no manual screen-reader, zoom/reflow, cognitive or full keyboard-order audit was done.
Items axe marks as needing manual review were counted but not reviewed.
Static viewer pages only; the console pages keep their 5 October result.
One desktop viewport; no mobile viewport or high-contrast mode.
